messages:
anya: change window in 10m for v3.14. starting small canary for embed routes. i'll post rolling health. please watch SLOs and call out anomalies. :eyes:

deploy-bot: AUTO: canary alpha -> 5% traffic. running probes: embed_p95, route_5xx, kvcache_miss, worker_rss. snapshot in 30s.

sam: quick heads-up 1: last perf run showed occasional model-worker OOMs under burst traffic in staging. watching memory on canary nodes.

observability-bot: SYNTHETIC: /health 200 in 145ms (baseline 130ms).

deploy-bot: LIVE: canary at 12%. metrics: embed_p95=190ms, embed_5xx=0.1%, kv_miss=5.2%, worker_rss=1.9GB. no auto-pause.

ryan: reminder: auto-pause if 5xx >= 0.5% OR p95 delta >= +180ms for 3m. manual mitigations allowed first.

kevin-m: seeing small RSS spikes on node-a around T+6m. planning to apply a mem-guard: limit worker threads to 75% on canary if spikes continue.

san: running targeted probe: `./ops/probe --route=embed --qps=40 --dur=2m`.

sam: probe result: embed_p95 peaked 220ms briefly, 5xx remained <0.2%. looks like memory churn not full failure.

anya: apply mem-guard to canary nodes (reduce concurrency) and enable a short-lived circuit-breaker for external upstreams. document change. hold canary +10m.

kevin-m: applied `mem_guard=true` and `worker.concurrency=0.75` on canary nodes (3 nodes). confirming reduced RSS.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: canary hold +10m requested by anya. traffic steady at 12%.

observability-bot: MONITOR: temporary rule `v3_14_mem_guard` created: if embed_p95 > 240ms OR embed_5xx > 0.5% for 3m -> alert.

sam: post-mitigation: embed_p95=160ms, embed_5xx=0.07%, kv_miss=5.6%, worker_rss=1.5GB. stable.

ryan: good signal. leave mitigation for GA and schedule follow-ups: revert in maintenance, add mem-stress CI test, and add autoscale by rss.

anya: agreed. i've pinned canary config `v3.14-canary-memguard-20260321` and updated changeboard & release notes. ramp to 40% in 5m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: PROGRESS: ramping to 40%. scaling nodes 3 -> 14.

sam: post-ramp samples look steady: p95 ~162ms, 5xx 0.09%. no rollback. :thumbsup:

anya: leaving thread open for 8m for final checks. if stable we'll mark deploy:succeeded and file infra follow-ups.

deploy-bot: FINAL STATUS (in 7m): rollout completed to 100% with mem-guard in place; no auto-pauses. tagging for postmortem+follow-ups.

anya: closing 1: mem-guard mitigation worked. follow-ups: revert on maintenance, add mem-stress test, and bake rss autoscaling. thanks all. :party:
